name: Drugnews Biotech Capital-Market Radar
description: Latest Drugnews articles grouped by biotech capital-market signals such as BD/licensing, valuation, clinical catalysts, CMC risk, GLP-1, oncology precision medicine, AI drug development, and big-pharma strategy.

articles.title: 美股迎來史上最大 Biotech IPO
articles.summary: 台股生技板塊還在低谷裡掙扎，美股生技市場卻突然打出一個極端反差。

articles.title: The FDA Tone Has Shifted: Why Biotech’s Rebound Is Starting at the Regulatory Layer
articles.summary: Biotech’s recent rebound is not only a risk-on trade. FDA review signals, rare-disease flexibility, mRNA vaccine momentum, and renewed pharma M&A are changing how investors price clinical-stage assets.

articles.title: FDA 風向變了：Biotech 反攻訊號，正在從監管端亮起
articles.summary: 代表中小型 Biotech 的 XBI（SPDR S&P Biotech ETF）近期走勢強勁，資金也重新流入。照理說，在利率仍未完全放鬆、風險資產仍會被折現率壓制的環境下，高波動的 Biotech 不應該是最輕鬆的族群。

articles.title: Pancreatic Cancer Breakthrough: After RAS Inhibitors, PRMT5/MAT2A Combinations Open the Next Layer of Upside
articles.summary: Pancreatic cancer is moving into a new phase of precision combination therapy, as RAS inhibition meets MTAP-selective PRMT5 and MAT2A strategies.

articles.title: 胰臟癌再爆：RAS 抑制劑之後，PRMT5／MAT2A 聯合療法把想像空間再打開
articles.summary: 胰臟癌正在進入 RAS 抑制劑與 PRMT5／MAT2A 合成致死聯合療法的新階段，市場開始重新評估 daraxonrasib 作為治療骨架的價值。

articles.title: 默沙東 對 PD-1／VEGF 雙抗改口：Keytruda 王座還在，但下一代免疫底盤已經逼近
articles.summary: 在全球腫瘤藥市場裡，很少有一家公司比 Merck（默沙東）更懂 PD-1。

articles.title: GSK's US$10.6 Billion Nuvalent Deal Is Really a Bet on Resistance and Brain Metastases
articles.summary: GSK is not merely buying three lung-cancer pipelines. It is buying a next-generation precision-oncology strategy around resistance, CNS activity, and cleaner kinase inhibition.

articles.title: GSK 用 106 億美元買下 Nuvalent：真正買的不是三條肺癌管線，而是「耐藥與腦轉移」的下一代解法
articles.summary: 2026 年 6 月 9 日，GSK 宣布以 106 億美元全現金收購 Nuvalent，收購價格為每股 124 美元，較 Nuvalent 前一交易日收盤價溢價約 40%。這是 GSK 近年最大型的腫瘤併購之一，也讓它瞬間補上肺癌精準治療版圖中最缺的一塊。

articles.title: ASCO 2026: RAS, ADCs, Bispecifics, and In Vivo CAR-T Point to a New Oncology Cycle
articles.summary: ASCO 2026 showed that oncology is moving from single-mechanism breakthroughs toward platform combinations across RAS targeting, ADCs, PD-1/VEGF bispecifics, and in vivo CAR-T.

articles.title: 2026 ASCO：生存期翻倍、體內 CAR-T 破局，腫瘤治療正在換一個時代
articles.summary: 2026 年美國臨床腫瘤學會年會，也就是 ASCO，最該被記住的贏家，並不是任何一家藥廠，而是癌症患者。

articles.title: Revolution Medicines: Why Biotech Winners Need Capital Strategy, Not Just Good Science
articles.summary: Revolution Medicines shows why next-generation biotech companies need to convert clinical momentum into capital momentum if they want to finish expensive global drug-development races.

articles.title: Revolution Medicines 神話：會研發還不夠，會融資才撐得過新藥長跑
articles.summary: 2026 年，全球最受矚目的 Biotech 之一，毫無疑問是 Revolution Medicines。這家公司站在一個極難、也極誘人的位置：RAS-addicted cancers。

articles.title: Tirzepatide Enters Autoimmune Disease: Is Immunometabolism Lilly's Next Expansion Path?
articles.summary: Lilly is testing whether tirzepatide can move beyond weight loss and become part of an immunometabolism strategy for chronic immune-inflammatory diseases.

articles.title: 神藥 猛健樂 Tirzepatide 進軍自體免疫，只差臨門一腳？
articles.summary: 它不像急性感染，用藥幾天或幾週就結束。類風濕性關節炎、乾癬、乾癬性關節炎、發炎性腸道疾病、氣喘、異位性皮膚炎，這些疾病往往跟著患者一輩子。

articles.title: The Race for the Third Obesity-Drug Giant: Who Comes After Lilly and Novo Nordisk?
articles.summary: Lilly and Novo Nordisk dominate the first phase of the obesity-drug market. The next investment question is who can become the third major player by solving the problems GLP-1 leaders have not fully solved.

articles.title: 減重藥「第三名」爭奪戰：禮來 與 諾和諾德 之外，誰能成為下一個代謝巨頭？
articles.summary: 今年 ADA，也就是美國糖尿病學會年會，減重藥戰場又一次被點燃。

articles.title: GLP-1「頭對頭」大戰：輝瑞＆諾和諾德必有一戰？
articles.summary: ADA 2026 剛落幕，GLP-1 賽道又被一組頭對頭資料點燃。Ecnoglutide 在 20 週減重數字上勝出，但真正的競爭不只看短期體重下降，而是長期健康結局、耐受性、產品矩陣與全球商業化。

articles.title: Ecnoglutide Versus Wegovy: A 20-Week Head-to-Head Signal Is Not the Same as a New GLP-1 King
articles.summary: Ecnoglutide's head-to-head weight-loss data versus semaglutide are interesting, but the GLP-1 race will be decided by long-term outcomes, tolerability, labels, supply, and global evidence.

articles.title: 禮來 38 億美元買三家疫苗公司：減肥藥巨頭，為什麼突然回頭買「預防醫學」？
articles.summary: 市場現在最熟悉的禮來，是 Mounjaro、Zepbound 背後那個 GLP-1 巨頭。2026 年第一季，禮來營收達到 198 億美元，年增 56%，主要動能還是來自 Mounjaro 與 Zepbound 的放量。簡單說，禮來現在手上最強的現金流，是減重與糖尿病藥物。

articles.title: Obesity Becomes King: How GLP-1 Is Reshuffling Global Biotech Capital
articles.summary: GLP-1 is no longer only a weight-loss topic. It is redirecting biotech capital, BD urgency, manufacturing attention, and valuation imagination across global pharma.

articles.title: 減肥成王：GLP-1 正在把全球生技資本重新洗牌
articles.summary: GLP-1 不只是減重藥題材，而是重新配置全球藥廠研發預算、產能投資、BD 談判與生技估值規則的核心變數。

articles.title: 邁向「寵物醫療界羅氏」的寶泰生醫
articles.summary: 當毛孩高齡化趨勢推動癌症、心臟病與自體免疫等重症治療的需求升級，市場的長期觀察核心，在於誰能率先打造一座寵物重症新藥平台，成為『寵物醫療界羅氏』。而這一改寫行業格局的答案，正於台灣的一家生技公司加速浮現。

articles.title: Is the First AI-Designed Drug Finally Arriving? Takeda's Zasocitinib Beats Sotyktu Head-to-Head
articles.summary: Takeda's zasocitinib beat Sotyktu in a head-to-head Phase 3 psoriasis study, turning AI-enabled drug design into a real commercial test.

articles.title: AI製藥，第一藥終於要來了嗎？武田 Zasocitinib 頭對頭打敗 Sotyktu
articles.summary: 過去，口服藥在中重度乾癬市場裡，常常扮演的是「方便但療效有限」的角色。真正能把皮膚清得很乾淨的，仍然是 Skyrizi（risankizumab，瑞莎奇珠單抗）、Tremfya（guselkumab，古塞奇尤單抗）、Cosentyx（secukinumab，司庫奇尤單抗）、Taltz（ixekizu…

articles.title: Enlivex's RAIN Token Windfall: When a Biotech Balance Sheet Starts Looking Like Crypto Treasury Strategy
articles.summary: Enlivex's paper gain from RAIN tokens shows how fragile biotech business models can create unusual treasury stories when operating revenue is absent and capital markets are difficult.

articles.title: 【Enlivex 的幣圈豪賭：Biotech 沒收入，卻靠 RAIN 代幣賺出 12 億美元帳面利潤】
articles.summary: 一家臨床階段 Biotech，沒有藥品銷售收入，卻在一年內做出 12 億美元級別的淨利。

articles.title: The Next Phase of AI Drug Development: Making Molecules Survive as Drugs
articles.summary: AI drug development is moving from molecular generation to clinical survival. AnHorn Medicines shows how AI+PROTAC, experimental feedback, and human translation may form a Taiwan-born clinical-asset engine.

articles.title: AI製藥下半場：讓藥活下來
articles.summary: AI 醫藥上半場比生成分子，下半場比成藥存活率。安宏真正值得被看見的，不是單純曝光，而是用 AI + PROTAC（蛋白質降解技術）、實驗閉環與人體轉譯，嘗試形成高資本效率的 clinical asset engine（臨床資產生成引擎）。

articles.title: Where Does AI Drug Discovery Stand Now? A Pipeline-Based Reality Check
articles.summary: AI drug discovery has moved beyond the concept stage and into clinical validation. This article reviews Zasocitinib, GB-0895, Zovegalisib, and REC-4881 to examine how different AI strategies are being converted into real drug assets.

articles.title: 盤點整理，AI藥物開發走得如何了？
articles.summary: AI 製藥已從概念走向臨床驗證。這篇盤點 Zasocitinib、GB-0895、Zovegalisib、REC-4881 等代表管線，拆解不同 AI 路線如何轉化成真正的藥物資產。
